item.title: North Chicago-based AbbVie investing $380 million on new pharmaceutical plants
item.description: <p>Global drugmaker AbbVie will invest $380 million to build two new manufacturing facilities at its North Chicago campus, the company said on Monday.</p><p>The plants will make active pharmaceutical ingredients for AbbVie’s obesity and neuroscience medications. item.title: WGN TV lays off 8-9 on-air talents Monday in major shake-up
item.description: <p>Newsrooms at Chicago TV stations are buzzing after hearing about a round of layoffs at WGN that affected several on-air talents, a circumstance that has touched local network affiliates but rarely has hit “Chicago’s Very Own.”</p><p>The Sun-Times has learned that 8-9 camera-facing employees were let go Monday, following recent layoffs behind the scenes that included writers. They come as WGN parent company Nexstar is working to merge with Tegna in a deal that’s under regulatory review.</p><p>
